title: Cub Cadet Ultima ZT1 42&#8243; Zero-Turn Riding Lawn Mower – 547cc IntelliPower Engine with Dual Hydrostatic Drive
description:
The
Cub Cadet Ultima Series ZT1 42IP
is built to deliver professional-grade performance and a flawless cut every time. Powered by a
547cc Cub Cadet IntelliPower engine, it provides up to 18% more available power to handle tall, thick, or even wet grass without slowing down. With its dual hydrostatic transmission, you’ll enjoy smooth control, quick acceleration, and mowing speeds of up to 7 MPH forward and 3.5 MPH in reverse.
A 42-inch twin-blade steel cutting deck ensures clean, even results while reducing mowing time, and the 15-position adjustable deck height (1″–4.5″) allows you to dial in the perfect cut for your lawn. The heavy-duty tubular steel frame with corrosion defense is designed for long-lasting durability, while premium comfort features like the ergonomic 20″ high-back seat, adjustable lap bars, and polymer suspension system reduce fatigue during extended use.
Large 20-inch turf tires provide excellent traction without damaging grass, while the 11-inch smooth front wheels pivot effortlessly for zero-turn precision. With a 3-year unlimited hours warranty and lifetime frame warranty, the Ultima ZT1 42IP is built for reliability, comfort, and long-term performance.
Key Features:
547cc Cub Cadet IntelliPower engine – up to 18% more power in tough conditions
42″ dual-blade cutting deck – delivers a smooth, even cut with less clumping
Dual hydrostatic drive system – quick, effortless zero-turn maneuverability
Cutting speed – up to 7 MPH forward / 3.5 MPH reverse
15-position deck height adjustment – from 1″ to 4.5″ for precision cutting
Heavy-duty 2″ x 2″ tubular steel frame – fully e-coated for corrosion resistance
Premium comfort seat & adjustable lap bars – reduce operator fatigue
Large turf-friendly tires – improved traction with minimal turf damage
3.5-gallon fuel tank – extended mowing sessions without frequent refueling
3-year limited warranty + lifetime frame warranty
Perfect for: Residential lawns 1–2 acres, flat or hilly terrain with obstacles.
